import base64
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from ios.tools.sim_drive import _usable_video, record
from ios.tools.tests.test_sim_drive import MOV_BASE64, UDID, install_record_xcrun

def atom(kind, payload):
 return (8+len(payload)).to_bytes(4,'big')+kind+payload
media=atom(b'mdhd',bytes(24))+atom(b'hdlr',bytes(8)+b'vide')
track=atom(b'tkhd',bytes(84))+atom(b'mdia',media)
payload=atom(b'moov',atom(b'mvhd',bytes(100))+atom(b'trak',track))+atom(b'mdat',b'x')
with TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
 root=Path(directory); bad=root/'incomplete.mov'; bad.write_bytes(payload)
 good=root/'valid.mov'; good.write_bytes(base64.b64decode(MOV_BASE64))
 assert not _usable_video(bad), 'Incomplete MOV still accepted'
 assert _usable_video(good), 'Real embedded MOV rejected'
 binary=root/'bin'; binary.mkdir(); calls=root/'calls.log'; install_record_xcrun(binary,calls)
 first=record(UDID,root/'out',1,system_name='Darwin',which=lambda _:str(binary/'xcrun'))
 second=record(UDID,root/'out',1,system_name='Darwin',which=lambda _:str(binary/'xcrun'))
 assert first['exit_code']==second['exit_code']==0,(first,second)
 assert first['artifact']!=second['artifact']
 assert _usable_video(Path(first['artifact'])) and _usable_video(Path(second['artifact']))
 assert calls.read_text().count('SIGINT')==2
 print({'missing_sample_table_rejected':True,'real_embedded_mov_accepted':True,'fresh_recordings_preserved':True,'graceful_SIGINT_count':2,'real_macos_exercised':False})
PY
